result.summary: Found 1 layout issue: the scrollable content container lacks proper bottom padding, causing the bottom navigation bar to overlap and obscure the lower items.

issues.description: The main scrollable view does not account for the height of the fixed bottom navigation bar, causing the bottom-most restaurant card to be obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable container so users can fully scroll past the bottom navigation bar and view the last card.
